'''Betha Tangrill''' was a representative of the [[Smugglers' Alliance]]. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] contacted Tangrill about the Smugglers' Alliance's proposed investment in [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations.<ref name="JAS" />
